constraints: statement must be a single line of code; control-flow statements (If, While, Return, Break, etc.) are not allowed and are silently ignored if present.
Does nothing if statement is an empty string.
In a compiled database, the statement is executed uninterpreted by the compiler (not compiled), so it is not checked at compile time.
For calling a project method with parameters, prefer EXECUTE METHOD instead.

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Evaluates and executes a single line of 4D code built or supplied at runtime (e.g. a user-entered expression), such as a command call, method call, or assignment.
